explanation: Aldous Huxley's novel came out 17 years before George Orwell's. Years earlier, Huxley had briefly taught French at Eton, where one of his pupils was Eric Blair, the future Orwell.

claims.text: Aldous Huxley's Brave New World was first published in 1932.
George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four was first published in 1949.
Aldous Huxley briefly taught French at Eton College, where Eric Blair, later known as George Orwell, was one of his pupils.
Brave New World appeared 17 years before Nineteen Eighty-Four.
